hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Prediction market Uniswap v4 hook implementing VALS (Volatile Adverse-Liquidity Sensitivity) dynamic swap fees. Requires a signed sigma parameter per swap (from a trusted off-chain signer); reverts without it. Fees are captured as a BeforeSwapDelta and redirected to a YieldDistributor for share token holders, not LPs. Tracks LP virtual balances and updates pool prices after each swap.
